decisions.reason: A two-year-old handle family in a long-lifecycle architectural hardware range would rarely be withdrawn this early.
The mitred handle family needed specialised tooling and fits the coordinated design range, so keeping it lets that investment pay off.
A multifunctional lever supports the firm's barrier-free system strategy and remains relevant to planners.
Planner-specified door lever lines are typically supplied for many years to cover follow-up orders.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection is a flagship design line with its own page and strong market visibility.
The bronze finish draws on in-house finishing expertise, applies across many models and costs little to keep offering.
